question.en: Where was the Statue of Liberty made?
question.zh: 自由女神像是哪里制造的？

sentences.en: Where was the Statue of Liberty made?
sentences.zh: 自由女神像是哪里制造的？

sentences.en: One of the most famous monuments in the world, the Statue of Liberty,
sentences.zh: 世界上最著名的纪念碑之一——自由女神像，

sentences.en: was presented to the USA in the nineteenth century by the people of France.
sentences.zh: 是19世纪时由法国人民赠送给美国的。

sentences.en: which was designed by the sculptor Auguste Bartholdi, took ten years to complete.
sentences.zh: 由雕塑家奥古斯特·巴托尔迪设计，花了十年才完成。

sentences.en: The actual figure was made of copper supported by a metal framework which had been especially constructed by Eiffel.
sentences.zh: 雕像本身是铜制的，由埃菲尔特制的一个金属框架支撑着。

sentences.en: Before it could be transported to the United States,
a site had to be found for it and a pedestal had to be built.
sentences.zh: 必须先选定一个地点，并建好一个底座。

sentences.en: The site chosen was an island at the entrance of New York Harbour.
sentences.zh: 选中的地点是纽约港入口处的一个岛。

sentences.en: By 1884, a statue which was 151 feet tall had been erected in Paris.
sentences.zh: 到1884年，一座高151英尺的雕像已在巴黎竖起。

sentences.en: The following year, it was taken to pieces and sent to America.
sentences.zh: 第二年，它被拆成小块运往美国。

sentences.en: the statue had been put together again and it was officially presented to American people by Bartholdi.
sentences.zh: 雕像重新组装起来，由巴托尔迪正式赠送给美国人民。

sentences.en: Ever since then, the great monument has been a symbol of liberty
sentences.zh: 从那时起，这座巨大的纪念碑一直是自由的象征，

sentences.en: for the millions of people who have passed through New York Harbour to make their homes in America.
sentences.zh: 对于途经纽约港到美国安家落户的数百万人来说。
